title: Expenses tab layout differs from web: no month-total bar or %-vs-last-month chip, no donut+legend card, different filter pills
web_ref: apps/web/src/components/pets/pet-expenses-body.tsx:73-115 (data incl. lastMonth/pctChange), 131-154 (total bar card), 157-197 (donut+legend card), 202-224 (8 fixed filter pills incl. 全部)
current_ios: Plain '{month} 月開銷' text heading, then a centered bare donut. Below it, the legend doubles as toggle pills, shown only for categories that have spend, with a dot and a $amount. There is no total-bar card, no percent change vs last month, no 'byCategory / N 項' legend card with per-row %, and no '全部' pill.
target: In order, matching web: (1) Total bar card: radius.xl (18), hairline border, card bg, shadows.card, padding 16x14, row space-between. Left: monthTitle (11px, 700, uppercase, letterSpacing .4, ink3), then 'NT$' (12px, 600, ink3, mr 4) + total (24px, 800, letterSpacing -.5, ink). Right, when lastTotal>0: pill chip (px10 py4, 11.5px, 700) with expenses.monthCompare {sign,pct}. Chip uses leafTint/leaf when pct<0, else cookieTint/cookie. (2) Donut+legend card: same card style, padding 14, row gap 14. 128px donut on the left. Right column (flex1, gap 10): header row with expenses.byCategory (12.5px, 700, ink) and expenses.itemCount {count} (11px, 600, ink3). Then per slice a row: 10px swatch (radius 3), label (12.5px, 600, ink2, flex1), pct% (13px, 800, ink, minWidth 28, right), $value (11px, 600, ink3, minWidth 52, right). (3) Horizontal ScrollView of 8 fixed filter pills [all, ...EXPENSE_CATEGORIES]: height 32, px 12, 12px 600, radius.pill. Active is brand bg with white text. Inactive is card bg, 1px hairline border, ink2. Label Filter.all or Expense.categories.*. (4) The list (see PETS-5). Filter state 'all' | category affects only the list. filterEmpty shows when the filter has no rows.
fix_plan: Rewrite PetExpensesBody: compute monthStart and lastMonthStart (new Date(y, m-1, 1)), thisMonth, lastMonth, total, lastTotal, and pctChange = lastTotal===0 ? null : Math.round((total-lastTotal)/lastTotal*100). Keep slices sorted desc. Replace the monthTitle Text plus the centered donutWrap with the two cards above. Replace the legend Pressables with `<ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={{gap:6}}>` holding the 8 pills, with state `filter: 'all' | ExpenseCategory` (default 'all'). Reuse ExpenseDonut unchanged (it already matches web geometry). The new props onEdit/onDelete/onAdd come from pets.tsx (see PETS-5 and PETS-12).

current_ios: Tab rows are ExpenseRow, a different design: radius.lg (14), a 38px circular emoji icon with 33% category tint, 'M/D · category' sub-line, '$amount', and no actions. A mis-scanned AI expense can't be fixed or removed from the app.
target: Each row is PetExpenseCard (already ported) with edit and delete. Edit opens ExpenseForm in edit mode prefilled from the expense. Delete asks for confirmation with title Common.delete, message `${vendor ?? ''} · NT$ ${amount}`, and a destructive Common.delete button.
fix_plan: (1) pet-expenses-body.tsx: render `<PetExpenseCard expense={e} onEdit={() => onEdit(e)} onDelete={() => onDelete(e)} />` for each filtered row and delete expense-row.tsx. (2) pets.tsx: add FormState `{ kind: 'expense'; editing?: Expense; ... }`. Pass `onEdit={(e) => setForm({kind:'expense', editing:e})}` and `onDelete={confirmDeleteExpense}`. confirmDeleteExpense = Alert.alert(tC('delete'), `${e.vendor ?? ''} · NT$ ${groupThousands(e.amount)}`, [cancel, {text:tC('delete'), style:'destructive', onPress: async () => { await deleteExpense(e.expenseId); refresh(); }}]), with try/catch that alerts on failure. title: Health records can't be deleted on iOS
current_ios: A wrong weight or vaccine entry is permanent from the app. A wrong weight record also stays in the weight trend.
target: A trash button on each health record card (32x32, radius.sm, ink3 Trash2 size 16). Tapping it confirms with Common.delete and a destructive button, then calls deleteHealthRecord and reloads.
fix_plan: Add `onDelete?: () => void` to HealthRecordCard and render a Pressable with Trash2 at the right of the header row (see PETS-7 layout), accessibilityLabel tC('delete'). In PetHealthBody accept `onDelete(record)`, or handle it internally: Alert.alert(tC('delete'), '', [cancel, {destructive, onPress: async () => { await deleteHealthRecord(petId, r.recordId); reload(); }}]). Use the `reload` returned by useHealthRecords.

Tints are weight brandTint, feeding cookieTint, vaccine leafTint, vet peachTint, medication bellTint, all different from web.
target: Web: card radius.xl (18), hairline border, shadows.card, padding 14. Header row (gap 12): a 42px rounded square (radius 14) with tone bg and a lucide icon (size 18, stroke 1.8). Icons and tones: weight Scale on leafTint/leaf; vaccine Syringe on brandTint/brandDeep; vet Stethoscope on peachTint/cookie; feeding UtensilsCrossed on brandTint/brandDeep; medication Pill on cookieTint/cookie. Then a column with the type label (Health.types.*, 11px, 700, uppercase, letterSpacing .6, tone fg) and the title (14.5px, 700, ink, 1 line). fix_plan: Rewrite health-record-card.tsx per target, using lucide-react-native { Scale, UtensilsCrossed, Syringe, Stethoscope, Pill, Trash2 } and colors.* tokens. title: Receipt scanner: no 'choose from library', wrong permission-denied copy, no preview/retake, no Settings link

current_ios: Only live-camera capture is possible, so a receipt already saved in Photos can't be scanned. The shutter immediately uploads to AI with no preview or retake. When permission is denied, the sheet title shows the unrelated '本月還沒有開銷' and offers no way to open iOS Settings when canAskAgain is false. target: Camera view adds a secondary 'library' button (lucide Image icon) next to the shutter, using expo-image-picker launchImageLibraryAsync. After capture or pick, show a preview step: the image (contain) with an X (retake), a primary btn-mango '開始辨識' with Sparkles (spinner + scanner.scanning while scanning), a manual-entry link, and optionally a save-to-album icon via expo-media-library. Denied state: title scanner.cameraDeniedTitle, body cameraDeniedBody, and an 'Open Settings' button (Linking.openSettings()) when !permission.canAskAgain, plus library-pick and manual-entry fallbacks.
fix_plan: In receipt-scanner.tsx add state `previewUri`. capture() and pickFromLibrary() set previewUri. A scan() runs compressReceiptToBase64 + extractReceipt. Render a preview branch. Fix the denied title. Import Linking from react-native. Primary buttons use LinearGradient mangoGradient with white text (design-system btn-mango). All copy comes from the PETS-13 scanner keys.
needs_new_i18n_keys: PetsPage.scanner.startScan = 開始辨識 | Read receipt
